profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Discover
profile.summary: Data Engineer with 15 years of experience working in a variety of platforms which include AWS, Spark, Big Data Technologies, Oracle, DataStage, Snowflake, Couchbase and Unix.  Participated in all phases of development, analysis, design, testing and production support.  Self-motivated and enjoy working in a collaborative environment.

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description:
*	Performed design, development and support of the Big Data solution on AWS and Cloudera Hadoop.
*	Converted Hive jobs into PySpark jobs.
*	Acted as a key developer in the effort to migrate data solutions from Hadoop into AWS.
*	Designed and built data sets and pipelines for Data Science Models using PySpark, Hive, Shell Script and SQOOP.
*	Led the effort to build the Consumer Entity and Match Maker Data sets. 
*	Built a migration process to move data out of Teradata and into Cloudera Hadoop.
*	Mentored interns, data developer colleagues and influenced the design pattern on several solutions.
*	Designed and developed ETL solutions for client solutions.
*	Led the effort to re-factor the Special Offers framework, which greatly improved the efficiency and accuracy of the data.
*	Designed and developed the Autocheck solution to request and ingest vehicle history data.
*	Led the effort to implement the STEBO STEP MDM tool and migrate all of Cars MDM data into the tool.  
*	Developed ETL jobs to push MDM data to STEP.
*	Built subject matter expertise on the Special Offers solution which links cash and finance vehicle incentives to dealers and vehicle listings.
*	Key developer in the design and development of the Dealer Rater Integration process.
*	Developed proficiency with the Hadoop SQOOP tool to import data from Teradata and PostgreSQL Databases to load data to Hive, HBase and Impala tables.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
* Perform hands-on ETL and Oracle development to create Marketing and/or Business Intelligence database solutions
* Independently use client’s tools, ETL framework, and Oracle to develop solution per specifications
* Design, document, and execute unit test cases.
* Author detailed process flow documentation.

positions.title: SOLUTION DEVELOPER
positions.description:
* Member of the remedy/release team responsible for making enhancements, fixes, new development and maintenance of Acxiom’s client solution.
* Accountable for the accuracy, process, integrity, quality and stewardship of client solution
ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
* Performed analysis, design and development for a major project to re-design the entire client solution.
* Provided mentoring and support for the new team members.
* Subject matter expert on all the batch processes on the data warehouse.

positions.title: DATABASE SOLUTION ANALYST
positions.description:
* Member of the production support team responsible for  identifying and resolving defects, tuning and making enhancements to improve efficiency and run times of production processes and supporting Client and business partner needs.
* Serve on the production team as the primary on call support for all the daily production processes.
* Responsible for support QAP and billing for outbound processes.
* Handled security tasks such as creating new user accounts, granting/revoking privileges and password resets.
* Member of the nightly On-Call rotation group
ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
* Developed strong debugging, analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix shell scripting and Perl programming skills.
* Made complex processes support friendly by breaking the process into easily restartable steps which simplified debugging and reduced downtime on failures.
* Volunteered and delivered on project work involving the design, development, tuning and enhancement of processes written in Korn Shell, Perl and SQL scripts.
* Managed to identify root causes of production anomalies such as orphaned and unconsolidated customer ID’s.
* Developed a strong understanding of production processes and can independently provide support and resolution for many production issues.

positions.title: SYSTEM ANALYST
positions.description:
* Perform technical system design for change orders or special projects by researching requirements, determining the impact of the change and associated risks.
* Carried out production Support by performing analysis and debugging for system errors and defects.
* Create documentation of system design changes, process flows for new processes and documentation for defect and system error resolution.
* Analysis handoff to the SCA for testing and configuration.
* Coordinate construction work by providing guidance on test plan creation, reviewing test plans, reviewing configuration, resolving any defects caught in testing and verifying successful deployment to production. 
* Provide coaching to help SCA's develop proficiency in their role and develop skills for the SA role.
ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
* Successfully managed small change order tasks and provided quick resolution for system errors and defects.
* Recognized as the subject matter expert for outbound-file processing to health care administrators, in-bound HR file processing, leave of absence process, Health Care Savings account administration, Student code processing and Medical plan options.

positions.title: SETUP CONFIGURATION ANALYST
positions.description:
* Provided support and setup to Hewitt's TBA system on DB2 to implement client provisions using formula language, customizable functions and logical drivers.
* Devised a detailed unit test plan to test all conditions through adding test case details for specific events.
Implemented test plans and verified all test results that match the expected outcome specified in the test plan.
* Performed debugging to unexpected results with the help of System Analyst to identify the source of the defect. 
* Maintained data integrity using SQL queries to identify inconsistencies with data as Production Support.
* Monitored system errors to identify defects and created workflows for defect resolution.
ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
* Became proficient with SDLC methodologies and processes
Used JCL to run batch jobs as part of the testing process ensuring all processes were properly tested and completed.
* Promoted to Senior SCA and performed analysis, debugging and project management for small change orders, defects and system errors.
* Led process for the setup of provisions involving the creation of files to be sent to health care administrators.
* Received team recognition awards for contributions to a successful Annual Enrollment project, and for outstanding work with the Connections implementation of Medicare changes for plan year 2006. 
* Developed strong understanding of TBA and how it interfaces with DB2.  Also took the initiative to perform debugging of system errors and defects.
